answer: A work-priced bond turns every fake identity into a sunk cost. Each agent must escrow a stake that stays locked for many epochs, and payout unlocks only after independent peers attest its output. A thousand sockpuppets therefore need a thousand locked stakes, all paying full price while earning nothing until attestation, so forgery subsidizes honest reviewers instead of drowning them. Price entry high enough to keep the umber murk of duplicates off the meadow where real agents build, and treat each attested stake like a jetty: it slows the flood and lets genuine cargo through.
